```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
remotes::install_github(c("ropensci/tabulapdf"))
usethis::use_package("daiR")
usethis::use_package("tesseract")
usethis::use_package("googlesheets4")
usethis::use_package("dplyr")
library(magrittr)
devtools::load_all()
```

## Import PDF data from West et al. 2001
West, J., S. O’Neill, G. Lippert, and S. Quinnell. 2001. Toxic contaminants in marine and anadromous fishes from Puget Sound, Washington. Washington Department of Fish and Wildlife, Olympia, Washington.

Time trends of persistent organic pollutants in benthic and pelagic indicator fishes from Puget Sound

```{r split_pdf, echo=FALSE}

#Split PDF in single pages needed for daiR package

savedir.pdf <- "~/readpcbpdfs/inputs/west2001"
dir.create(savedir.pdf)

pdf.list <- list.files(savedir.pdf, pattern = "*.*pdf", full.names = TRUE)

if(rlang::is_empty(pdf.list)==TRUE) {

tabulapdf::split_pdf("~/readpcbpdfs/inputs/tables_West_2001.pdf", outdir = savedir.pdf)
  
}


#tables have text with species names that was not straightforward to extract
# so I extracted it manually

googlesheets4::gs4_deauth()
species.link <- "1w5p-vemW2PjKbVQF-aWT5vi_CtTNdqeoOUr9lpMOTQU"
sp.sheet <- googlesheets4::read_sheet(species.link, sheet="species")

func.groups <- sp.sheet %>% 
  dplyr::distinct(common_name, functional_group)

# Use tidyverse to repeat each row the appropriate number of times
sp.sheet.expanded <- sp.sheet %>%
  dplyr::rowwise() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(row = list(rep(1:pages, each=1))) %>%
  tidyr::unnest(row) %>%
  dplyr::select(-pages)

# Write the resulting DataFrame to a new CSV file
readr::write_csv(sp.sheet.expanded, "species_samples.csv")


#not needed once the whole data.frame was expanded
#sp.list <- lapply(num.rows, get_sp, sp.sheet)
#sp.names <- purrr::list_c(sp.list)

#Extract tables

savedir.pdf <- "~/readpcbpdfs/inputs/west2001"

pdf.list <- list.files(savedir.pdf, pattern = "*.*pdf", full.names = TRUE)

no.pdf.files <- 1:length(pdf.list)

#This function extracts all text from the PDF
#ocr.text <- pdftools::pdf_ocr_text(pdf.list[1])

tables.file <- lapply(no.pdf.files, get_table_west, pdf.list, sp.sheet.expanded) 

pdf.dirname <- "west2001"

tables.raw <- tables.file %>% 
  dplyr::bind_rows() %>% 
  dplyr::filter(grepl("PCB", `Assay`)) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(PCB_congener= gsub("PCB","",Assay), unit = "ug/kg") %>% 
  dplyr::select(Location, common_name, PCB_congener, unit, sample, Mean)

tables.summary <- tables.raw %>% 
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = PCB_congener, values_from = Mean) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(citation=pdf.dirname, sample_no = 1:dplyr::n()) %>% 
  dplyr::rename(location = Location, tot_pcb=Total) %>% 
  dplyr::left_join(func.groups, by = "common_name") %>% 
  dplyr::select(citation, sample_no, location, common_name, functional_group, sample, dplyr::everything())
  

#write and read again to make data as double
readr::write_csv(tables.summary, here::here("outputs",paste0(pdf.dirname,".csv")))

sed.csv <-readr::read_csv(here::here("outputs",paste0(pdf.dirname,".csv"))) 

#saved locations, added corresponding Atlantis polygon
locs.west <- sed.csv %>% 
  dplyr::distinct(location)

readr::write_csv(locs.west, here::here("outputs",paste0("locations_",pdf.dirname,".csv")))

tables.data <- sed.csv %>% 
 dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(tidyr::everything(), ~tidyr::replace_na(.x, 0))) 

#write again to add 0 values
readr::write_csv(tables.data, here::here("outputs",paste0(pdf.dirname,".csv")))

googlesheets4::gs4_deauth()
species.link <- "1w5p-vemW2PjKbVQF-aWT5vi_CtTNdqeoOUr9lpMOTQU"
loc.sheet <- googlesheets4::read_sheet(species.link, sheet="west2001_locations", col_types = c("ci"))

#calculate ratios
#sum coeluting PCBs
#ratio_118=`118`/tot_pcb 
#ratio_153=`153/168` 
#ratio_138=`129/138/160/163/164`/tot_pcb

#could not add the coeluting congeners because they were not reported in the results, they only include the most common data
tables.selec <- tables.data %>% 
  dplyr::left_join(loc.sheet, by="location") %>% 
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(atlantis_polygon)) %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(ratio_118=`118`/tot_pcb, per_118=ratio_118*100, 
                ratio_153=(`153`)/tot_pcb, per_153=ratio_153*100, 
                ratio_138=(`138`)/tot_pcb, per_138=ratio_138*100,
                strata = "sampling location", year = "1989-1999") %>% 
  dplyr::select(citation, sample_no, strata, atlantis_polygon, common_name, functional_group, sample, year, unit, dplyr::contains("ratio_"), dplyr::contains("per_"),tot_pcb)


ratio.loc.plot <- tables.selec %>% 
  dplyr::select(citation, atlantis_polygon, functional_group, contains("per")) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(atlantis_polygon=as.factor(atlantis_polygon)) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols=per_118:per_138, names_to = "ratios", values_to="value") %>% 
   ggplot2::ggplot(ggplot2::aes(x= atlantis_polygon, y = value, colour = ratios))+
  ggplot2::geom_boxplot() +
  ggplot2::facet_wrap(.~ functional_group)+
  ggplot2::labs(title= "Congener:total PCB ratio", 
                subtitle = "West et al. 2001",
                y="Percent of total PCBs",
                x= "Atlantis polygon")

ratio.loc.plot

readr::write_csv(tables.selec, here::here("outputs",paste0(pdf.dirname,"_pcb_ratios.csv")), append = FALSE)
```

#Extract 
Burd, B. J., T. A. Macdonald, R. W. Macdonald, and P. S. Ross. 2014. Distribution and uptake of key polychlorinated biphenyl and polybrominated diphenyl ether congeners in benthic infauna relative to sediment organic enrichment. Archives of environmental contamination and toxicology 67:310–334.

```{r}

#Split PDF in single pages needed 

pdf.filename <- "tables_Burd_2014.pdf"

pdf.dirname <- "burd2014"

split_pdf(pdf.filename, pdf.dirname)

#Extract tables

pdf.list <- list.files(here::here("inputs",pdf.dirname), pattern = "*.*pdf", full.names = TRUE)

no.pdf.files <- 1:length(pdf.list)

#Had to use extract:areas because it thinks the PDF area is empty
#It is interactive so had to use a for loop

table.data <- list()

for(eachpdf in no.pdf.files){
 
print(eachpdf)
this.pdf <- pdf.list[eachpdf]

print(this.pdf)

tables.file <- tabulapdf::extract_areas(this.pdf)
 
print(tables.file)

table.data[[eachpdf]] <- tables.file
  
}
 
this.colnames.1 <- table.data[[1]][[1]][1,] %>% 
   tidyr::separate(col=`PCB Congener`, into=c("28","31"), sep=" ") %>% 
  as.character()

secc.1.1 <- table.data[[1]][[1]][2:19,] %>% 
  tidyr::separate(col=`PCB Congener`, into=c("28","31"), sep=" ") %>% 
  setNames(this.colnames.1) %>% 
  dplyr::select(-`NA`) %>% 
  dplyr::rename(station=Station)

   ggplot2::ggplot(ggplot2::aes(x= atlantis_polygon, y = value, colour = ratios))+
```

#Extract 
Conn, K.E., and Black, R.W., 2014, Data compilation for assessing sediment and toxic chemical loads from the Green River to the lower Duwamish Waterway, Washington: U.S. Geological Survey Data Series 880, 46 p., http://dx.doi. org/10.3133/ds880.

```{r}
#stored in Google sheets

pdf.dirname <- "conn2014"
googlesheets4::gs4_deauth()
  
sheet.link <- "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1w5p-vemW2PjKbVQF-aWT5vi_CtTNdqeoOUr9lpMOTQU/edit?gid=385519610#gid=385519610"

sed.bed <- googlesheets4::read_sheet(sheet.link, sheet = "conn_&_black_sed_bed") %>% 
  dplyr::filter(grepl("PCB", `Parameter Name`)) %>% 
  dplyr::select(sample, `Parameter Name`, dplyr::contains("Result")) %>% 
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols=3:ncol(.), names_to = "date", values_to = "value") %>% 
  tidyr::separate(`Parameter Name`, into=c("PCB","pcb_congener"), sep="-") %>% 
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = pcb_congener) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(tot_pcb = rowSums(dplyr::across(dplyr::where(is.numeric)), na.rm=TRUE)) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(functional_group=sample, sample = "sediment")

sed.susp <- googlesheets4::read_sheet(sheet.link, sheet = "conn_&_black_susp_sed") %>% 
  dplyr::filter(grepl("PCB", `Parameter Name`)) %>% 
  dplyr::select(sample, `Parameter Name`, dplyr::contains("Result")) %>% 
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols=3:ncol(.), names_to = "date", values_to = "value") %>% 
  tidyr::separate(`Parameter Name`, into=c("PCB","pcb_congener"), sep="-") %>% 
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = pcb_congener) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(tot_pcb = rowSums(dplyr::across(dplyr::where(is.numeric)), na.rm=TRUE)) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(functional_group=sample, sample = "sediment")

water <- googlesheets4::read_sheet(sheet.link, sheet = "conn_&_black_water") %>% 
  dplyr::filter(grepl("PCB", `Parameter Name`)) %>% 
  dplyr::select(sample, `Parameter Name`, dplyr::contains("Result")) %>% 
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols=3:ncol(.), names_to = "date", values_to = "value") %>% 
  tidyr::separate(`Parameter Name`, into=c("PCB","pcb_congener"), sep="-") %>% 
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = pcb_congener) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(tot_pcb = rowSums(dplyr::across(dplyr::where(is.numeric)), na.rm=TRUE)) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(functional_group=sample, sample = "water")

pcb.samp <- dplyr::bind_rows(sed.bed, sed.susp, water) 
  

readr::write_csv(pcb.samp, here::here("outputs",paste0(pdf.dirname,".csv")))

#calculate ratios
#sum coeluting PCBs
#ratio_118=`118`/tot_pcb 
#ratio_153=`153/168` 
#ratio_138=`129/138/160/163/164`/tot_pcb

tables.selec <- pcb.samp %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(atlantis_polygon = "45", common_name = sample, unit = "pg/g", strata="sampling dates", year = "2013") %>%  #sampled in the Duwamish River
  dplyr::mutate(ratio_118=`118`/tot_pcb, per_118=ratio_118*100, 
                ratio_153=`153/168`/tot_pcb, per_153=ratio_153*100, 
                ratio_138=(`129/138/160/163`+`164`)/tot_pcb, per_138=ratio_138*100, 
                citation=pdf.dirname, sample_no = 1:dplyr::n(), strata="sampling location & date") %>% 
   dplyr::select(citation, sample_no, strata, atlantis_polygon, common_name, functional_group, sample, year, unit, dplyr::contains("ratio_"), dplyr::contains("per_"),tot_pcb)


ratio.loc.plot <- tables.selec %>% 
  dplyr::select(citation, atlantis_polygon, functional_group, contains("per")) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(atlantis_polygon=as.factor(atlantis_polygon)) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols=per_118:per_138, names_to = "ratios", values_to="value") %>% 
   ggplot2::ggplot(ggplot2::aes(x= atlantis_polygon, y = value, colour = ratios))+
  ggplot2::geom_boxplot() +
  ggplot2::facet_wrap(.~ functional_group)+
  ggplot2::labs(title= "Congener:total PCB ratio", 
                subtitle = "Conn et al. 2014",
                y="Percent of total PCBs",
                x= "Atlantis polygon")

ratio.loc.plot


readr::write_csv(tables.selec, here::here("outputs",paste0(pdf.dirname,"_pcb_ratios.csv")), append = FALSE)  


```


#Extract
WADOE, 2015. Bellingham Bay Regional Background Sediment Characterization. Washington State Department of Ecology Toxics Cleanup Program Olympia, WA.

```{r}

pdf.filename <- "tables_WDOE_2015"

pdf.dirname <- "wdoe2015"

split_pdf(pdf.filename, pdf.dirname)

#Extract tables

pdf.list <- list.files(here::here("inputs", pdf.dirname), pattern = "*.*pdf", full.names = TRUE)

no.pdf.files <- 1:length(pdf.list)

#DO NOT SELECT table captions

tables.file <- lapply(no.pdf.files, get_table, pdf.list, pdf.dirname) 


tables.data.1 <- dplyr::bind_rows(tables.file[[1]],tables.file[[2]],tables.file[[3]]) %>% 
  dplyr::rename(pcb_congener = `Location ID`) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(!grepl("TEQ", pcb_congener)) %>% 
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols=2:ncol(.),names_to="station", values_to = "value") %>% 
  dplyr::filter(!grepl("Q...", station)) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(pcb_congener= gsub("PCB‐","",pcb_congener)) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(pcb_congener= gsub("Total PCBs\\*","tot_pcb",pcb_congener), value= gsub(" UJ","",value), value= gsub(" J","",value), value= gsub(" U","",value)) %>% 
  dplyr::arrange(station, pcb_congener) %>% 
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = pcb_congener, values_from = value) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(citation=pdf.dirname, sample_no = 1:dplyr::n()) 


tables.data.2 <- dplyr::bind_rows(tables.file[[4]],tables.file[[5]],tables.file[[6]]) %>% 
  dplyr::rename(pcb_congener = `Location ID`) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(`Location ID BB‐07‐S Q`= gsub("Total PCBs\\*","tot_pcb",`Location ID BB‐07‐S Q`)) %>% 
  tidyr::separate("Location ID BB‐07‐S Q", into=c("BB‐07‐S","value"), sep=" ") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(`BB‐07‐S Q`=dplyr::if_else(is.na(`value`), `BB‐07‐S Q`, `value`),
                pcb_congener=dplyr::if_else(is.na(pcb_congener), `BB‐07‐S`, pcb_congener)) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(pcb_congener!="PCB") %>% 
  dplyr::select(-`BB‐07‐S`, -`...3`, -`...4`, -`...8`, -value, -dplyr::contains("Q...")) %>% 
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols=2:ncol(.),names_to="station", values_to = "value") %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(pcb_congener= gsub("PCB‐","",pcb_congener), station= gsub(" Q","",station), station= gsub("Q ","",station)) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(value= gsub(" UJ","",value), value= gsub(" J","",value), value= gsub(" U","",value), value= gsub("J ","",value), value= gsub("U ","",value)) %>% 
  dplyr::arrange(station, pcb_congener) %>%
```

#Extract
Location Point Grey
Ross, P. S., K.A. Harris, N.J. Dangerfield, N.F. Crewe, C. Dubetz, M.B. Fischer, T.L. Fraser, and A.R.S. Ross 2011. Sediment concentrations of PCBs, PBDEs, PCDDs and PCDFs from disposal at sea sites at Point Grey and Sand Heads, British Columbia in 2010. Fisheries and Oceans Canada, Ottawa, Canada. Canadian Data Report of Fisheries and Aquatic Sciences 1239.

```{r}

pdf.filename <- "tables_Ross_2011_1.pdf"

pdf.dirname <- "ross2011_1"

split_pdf(pdf.filename, pdf.dirname)

#Extract tables
pdf.list <- list.files(here::here("inputs", pdf.dirname), pattern = "tables_Ross", full.names = TRUE)

no.pdf.files <- 1:length(pdf.list)

tables.file <- lapply(no.pdf.files, get_table, pdf.list, pdf.dirname) 

no.tables <- 1:length(tables.file)


#need to run this separately because there are actually two tables
rm(eachtable)
rm(current.table)

no.tables <- 1:14
for(eachtable in no.tables){
  
   
  thistable <- tables.file[[eachtable]]
  
  print(head(thistable))
 
  print("Rows in thistable")
  print(nrow(thistable))
  
  if(eachtable==1){
    print("First table")
    
    this.header <-  names(thistable) %>% 
      gsub("DiCB-","", .) %>% 
      gsub("TrCB-","", .) %>% 
      gsub("TeCB-","", .) %>% 
      gsub("PeCB-","", .) %>% 
      gsub("HxCB-","", .) %>% 
      gsub("HpCB-","", .) %>%
      gsub("OcCB-","", .) 
    
    names(thistable) <- this.header
    
    current.table <- thistable %>% 
      dplyr::rename(station=`...1`)
    
    
  } else if(eachtable>1){
    
    if(nrow(thistable)==nrow(current.table)){
      
      this.header <-  names(thistable) %>% 
        gsub("DiCB-","", .) %>% 
        gsub("TrCB-","", .) %>% 
        gsub("TeCB-","", .) %>% 
        gsub("PeCB-","", .) %>% 
        gsub("HxCB-","", .) %>% 
        gsub("HpCB-","", .) %>%
        gsub("OcCB-","", .) 
      
      names(thistable) <- this.header
      
      print("number of rows is the same")
      current.table <- thistable %>% 
        dplyr::select(-`...1`) %>% 
        # dplyr::full_join(current.table, ., by=c("station"))
        dplyr::bind_cols(current.table, .)
      
    } else {
      
      print("number of rows is different")
      
      this.header <- thistable[1,] %>% 
        as.character() %>% 
        gsub("DiCB-","", .) %>% 
        gsub("TrCB-","", .) %>% 
        gsub("TeCB-","", .) %>% 
        gsub("PeCB-","", .) %>% 
        gsub("HxCB-","", .) %>% 
        gsub("HpCB-","", .) %>%
        gsub("OcCB-","", .) 
      
      names(thistable) <- this.header
      
       
      current.table <- thistable[2:nrow(thistable),] %>% 
        dplyr::bind_cols(current.table, .)
      #dplyr::full_join(current.table, ., by=c("station"))
      
    }
  } 
  print("Cols in current table")
  print(ncol(current.table))
  
}


#second set of data
```

#Extract
WADOE. 2015. Port Gardner Bay Regional Background Sediment Characterization. Washington Department of Ecology. Publication no. 13-09-049.

C/C180 – the C indicates the congener co-elutes as a congener pair, if the C is followed by a number the results are reported with 
the congener pair 
U- the analyte was analyzed for but not detected 
J – the analyte was positively identified, the associated numerical value is the approximate concentration of the analyte in the 
sample 
B- analyte found in the sample and the associated blank 
K – identifies a target that could not be confirmed by virtue of not satisfying all method required criteria, the reported value may 
be interpreted as an estimated maximum analyte concentration 
TEQ – toxicity equivalency

```{r}
#other are polygons 1

res.table <- tables.file[[1]][2:nrow(tables.file[[1]]),] %>%
  magrittr::set_colnames(names.header) %>%
  dplyr::select(-dplyr::contains("log"), -dplyr::contains("BDE")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(Site %in% selec.locs) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(atlantis_polygon = dplyr::if_else(Site %in% pol.4, "4",
                                                dplyr::if_else(Site %in% pol.18, "18", "1"))) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(sample_no = 1:dplyr::n()) %>% 
  dplyr::select(sample_no, atlantis_polygon, PCB, dplyr::everything(),-Site, -Location, -`(m)`) %>% 
  dplyr::rename(tot_pcb=PCB) %>% 
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols=3:ncol(.), names_to="pcb_congener", values_to = "value") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(value=(gsub(",","", value))) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(value=as.numeric(value)) %>% 
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = pcb_congener, values_from = value) 
  

readr::write_csv(res.table, here::here("outputs",paste0(pdf.dirname,".csv")))

dplyr::mutate(unit = "ng/kg dry weight", year = "2010", functional_group = "sediment", common_name = "sediment", sample = "sediment", citation=pdf.dirname, strata = "sampling locations & dates")

  dplyr::select(citation, sample_no, strata, atlantis_polygon, common_name, functional_group, sample, year, unit, dplyr::contains("ratio_"), dplyr::contains("per_"),tot_pcb)


ratio.loc.plot <- tables.selec %>% 
  dplyr::select(citation, atlantis_polygon, functional_group, contains("per")) %>%
```

```{r}
 dplyr::mutate(Coelutions = dplyr::if_else(is.na(Coelutions),`IUPAC Number`, Coelutions)) %>%

  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = `IUPAC Number`, values_from = value) %>%
```

```{r}
for(eachsample in these.samples){
  
#  print(eachsample)

  #calculate ratios
#sum coeluting PCBs
#ratio_118=`118`/tot_pcb 
#ratio_153=`153/168` 
#ratio_138=`129/138/160/163/164`/tot_pcb
  
  this.sample.data <- all.samples %>% 
    dplyr::filter(sample_no==eachsample) %>% 
    dplyr::distinct(Catalog.Number, citation, sample_no, strata, atlantis_polygon, common_name, functional_group, sample, year, unit, pcb_congener, value) 
  
  tot.pcbs <- this.sample.data %>% 
    dplyr::group_by(Catalog.Number, citation, sample_no, strata, atlantis_polygon, common_name, functional_group, sample, year, unit) %>% 
    dplyr::summarise(value = sum(value)) %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(pcb_congener="tot_pcb")
  
  this.sample.con.data <- this.sample.data %>%
    dplyr::filter(grepl("118|153|138|168|129|160|163|164", pcb_congener)) %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(pcb_congener = dplyr::if_else(grepl("118", pcb_congener) , "118", 
                                    dplyr::if_else(grepl("153", pcb_congener), "153",
                                       dplyr::if_else(grepl("138", pcb_congener), "138", 
                                                      dplyr::if_else(grepl("168", pcb_congener), "168",pcb_congener))))) %>%
    dplyr::bind_rows(tot.pcbs) %>% 
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = pcb_congener, values_from = value) 
    
  
  
  
  print(colnames(this.sample.con.data))
  
  wide.data[[eachsample]] <- this.sample.con.data
    
}
```

```{r}

file.remove(here::here("outputs","all_pcb_ratios.csv"))
file.remove(here::here("outputs","mean_pcb_ratios.csv"))

res.files <- list.files(here::here("outputs"), pattern = "*_pcb_ratios.csv", full.names = TRUE)

all.pcb.ratios <- lapply(res.files, readr::read_csv)

no.files <- length(all.pcb.ratios)


year.corr <- list()


for(eachfile in 1:no.files){
  print(eachfile)
  
  year.corr[[eachfile]] <- all.pcb.ratios[[eachfile]] %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(year = as.character(year))
  
}

all.pcb.data <- dplyr::bind_rows(year.corr) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(common_name = tolower(common_name)) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(strata=dplyr::if_else(strata=="sampling locations","sampling location",
                                      dplyr::if_else(strata=="sampling locations & dates", "sampling location & date",
                                                     dplyr::if_else(strata=="sampling locations & date", "sampling location & date", strata)))) %>% 
   dplyr::mutate(unit=dplyr::if_else(unit=="ng/kg DW","ng/kg dry weight",
                                      dplyr::if_else(unit=="pg/g (wet weight)", "pg/g wet weight",
                                                     dplyr::if_else(unit=="pg/g (wet weight)", "pg/g wet weight", unit)))) %>% 
   dplyr::mutate(common_name=dplyr::if_else(common_name=="harbor seal","harbor seals",common_name)) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(functional_group=dplyr::if_else(functional_group=="sediment bed","sediment",
                  dplyr::if_else(functional_group=="particulate in seawater","detritus particulate in seawater", 
                  dplyr::if_else(functional_group=="dissolved in seawater","detritus dissolved in seawater", functional_group))))


test.duplicates <- all.pcb.data %>%
  dplyr::group_by(citation, sample_no, strata, atlantis_polygon, common_name, functional_group, sample, year, unit,tot_pcb) %>%  # Group by the columns you want to check for duplicates
  dplyr::filter(dplyr::n() > 1) %>%          # Keep only groups with more than one row (i.e., duplicates)
  dplyr::ungroup() 

readr::write_csv(all.pcb.data, here::here("outputs","all_pcb_ratios.csv"), append = FALSE)

mean.ratios <- all.pcb.data %>% 
  dplyr::group_by(functional_group) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(mean_ratio_118 = mean(ratio_118, na.rm=TRUE), 
                   mean_ratio_153 = mean(ratio_153, na.rm=TRUE), 
                   mean_ratio_138 = mean(ratio_138, na.rm=TRUE)) %>% 
  dplyr::ungroup()
```
